focus: Concurrency/failure boundaries and downstream phase decomposition

label: Assembler reconciles ordering/completion explicitly; tolerates unknown events (NFR-R02)
Per-runtime stream events mapped for ordering: Claude index/final, Codex turn/completed, Pi message_end, OpenCode SSE, Cursor/Devin agent_message_chunk
Ordering strategy: index/final where provided, completion-event anchor, arrival sequence otherwise
Buffering per stable hashed identity; private, locked, bounded, expired on missing final
Cancellation surfaces: Codex turn/interrupt, Cursor session/cancel, OpenCode /abort, Pi session_shutdown
Retry policy: bounded backoff for transient provider failures; never retry semantic validation rejection
Failure classes all select original with redacted reason; unsupported interception uses append/sidecar/custom client
Downstream phase map A-E: adapters+envelope, assembler+concurrency, codec+validator, providers+privacy, render+eval
Handoffs A>B, B>C, A>D, C>E, D>E; gates per child; rollback confined to research artifacts
Architecture freeze: plan component set compatible with all findings; no redesign required

direction: Share mutable assembler state across concurrent identities
